messages:
maya: Heads-up: my docs PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8471) is blocked by preview CI failures (link-check + vale). Can't merge until green and reviewer approves. Anyone able to triage?

devon: I can look now. Share the CI output so I can prioritize.

ci-bot: docs-preview: PR #8471 failures: link-checker: 2 broken anchors in guides/migrations.md; vale: 1 sentence-case rule violation in that file. Details: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/preview/8471

maya: I renamed a heading to "Breaking API changes" which likely changed the anchor slug. Also adjusted a few headings which Vale flagged.

alex: If it's just anchors we should update the refs in the three docs that point at that header. Patching refs is safer than adding raw HTML anchors.

maya: Agreed. Which files reference it?

ci-bot: Link-check output snippet:
```
./reference/changelog.md: broken link to #api-changes referenced from ./guides/migrations.md: line 102
./tutorials/upgrade.md: broken link to #upgrade-steps referenced from ./guides/migrations.md: line 14
```

devon: I'll open a small follow-up PR to update the two referencing links and fix the Vale heading case. Will tag reviewers.

sam: Quick reminder: our slug rules lower-case and replace spaces with dashes. Use `#breaking-api-changes` in targets.

alex: Branch `fix/8471-migration-refs` pushed with the three link edits and small heading tweak. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8472

devon: Reviewed and approved with one nit about link text wording.

maya: Nit addressed in PR 8472. @docs-bot rerun-preview please.

docs-bot: To rerun the preview, comment `@docs-bot rerun-preview` on the PR or run `/docs preview rerun 8471` in channel.

maya: @docs-bot rerun-preview

ci-bot: docs-preview: rerun queued for PRs #8471 and #8472. Jobs: link-checker, vale, md-lint.

ci-bot: docs-preview: all checks passed for PR #8471 and PR #8472. \u2705

maya: Thanks all! I'll merge during the 12:30 UTC docs merge window so it doesn't interfere with release publishing.

devon: Sounds good. Ping if anything else flakes.

sam: Noted for the docs publish schedule 16:00 UTC inclusion.

maya: Merged and queued for publish. Appreciated the quick responses :rocket:
